state:
**Goal `coalesce-assign` — Stages 2 and 3 are on disk; Stage 4 (the feature proofs and the reference) has nothing yet.**

`??+=`, `??-=` and `??.=` lex as one token each, parse as `AssignOp::CoalesceAddAssign`,
`CoalesceSubAssign` and `CoalesceConcatAssign`, and `AssignOp::defaults` says which ops default.
`check_compound_assign` types `$a = ($a ?? d) op $v` through `defaulted_read`, which records the
`??` under `AssignOp::defaulted_read_span` (target start to value start). `lower_read_modify_write`
reads that entry back in `Lowering::defaulted_read`, stages the zero under `synthetic_span`, and
lowers the same `??` the written-out form would. A type with no zero is its own `d`, so it meets
the plain operator's refusal; `rule:expressions/defaulting-assignment` says so and is `shipped`,
guarded by the two Stage 3 cases and `crates/nvs-types/tests/defaulting_assignment.rs`. Valgrind
over a `??.=` fixture (element, nested row, local, property, value position) is clean.

`nvs fmt` respaces no operator at all, `$a+=1` included; its test pins that the three format to
themselves rather than being refused.
